chapter: Family lore, Boston and Europe with Sam Price
title: Sam Price's band members and breaking away
summary: Doc Cheatham and J. C. Heard were in the band; he chafed at Sam Price's no-drinking rule.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: Tell me, do you remember some of the musicians who traveled with you in Sam Price's band? Who were some of the musicians in the band?
I forgot the trombone player's name. Doc Cheatham was one.
Doc Cheatham was in the band?
Yeah, and J. C. Heard. I got the pictures of all of them in there but I don't remember their names. I forget my name...
Where did you all work next after you came back to the States?

I think the band broke up. I did work another gig with Sam Price. That was a place about 53rd Street there and Seventh Avenue, a nightclub, you know, you could dance and whatnot. We stayed there for about two weeks. I did lots of gigs with him but I wanted to break with him. He didn't want you to drink; I cheated, called him all kinds of names. Wanted to know what kind of kindergarden was this. No drinking, no nothing.
